findings: The optional shared runtime is bound equally in the operation and inference manifest; preparation binds original wheelhouse and current project hashes while retaining exact trained model/code bytes.

Shared Dataset owner/ID/private/version1 and source-bound private offline T4 probe version1/completion/receipt hashes are verified before push and submission. The notebook independently binds full archive bytes and exact wheel/lock payload membership before offline install.

The existing durable SQLite intent/reconciliation logic remains in force; kernel absence preflight precedes the single SaveKernel mutation. Existing and additional focused tests refuse ambiguous mutation/retry paths.

The notebook keeps the checkpoint-only encoder config path and full strict trained-state inference route, uses extracted shared wheels with --no-index/--require-hashes, and never re-fetches original pretrained weights.

The PROFILE403 fallback is supported by attributed fresh read-only evidence:40 owned references on page1 including private probe, then valid empty protobuf page2 omitting kernels. Independent tests accept this omission but refuse later-page target presence, duplicate/foreign identities, invalid rows and nontermination. Primary installed SDK kernels_list sets group=profile when mine=True, then maps through KernelsListViewType; excerpt preserved.
operational_limits: This review did not execute live Kaggle GPU inference, create or update Datasets/notebooks, submit a competition entry, download wheels, or alter Newton. A real accepted version-bound probe remains required operationally.

Kaggle slug attachment plus preflight version checks is not server-side compare-and-swap. Exact input byte hashes prevent silent payload drift; keep the single account coordinator and never advance dedicated source versions.
The archive verification/extraction is appropriate to immutable Kaggle input mounts; no guarantee for concurrent hostile mutation of those mounted files is claimed.
Inherited tests emit a pytest_asyncio fixture-loop-scope deprecation warning; no failed tests.

tests.execution: Local existing workspace virtualenv; synthetic files/remotes; subprocess stub for offline notebook command construction. No actual package install or inference claimed by that stub.
